name.value: Crown Columbia Hotel, BW Premier Collection

description.value: Crown Columbia Hotel BW Premier Collection is a newly designed all-suite boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Trail, situated along the Columbia River. Every suite comes with a full kitchen and deluxe amenities, well-suited for touring cyclists needing a comfortable multi-night base. The central downtown location puts guests within easy walking distance of restaurants, coffee shops, the Cominco Arena, and the riverfront.
